full_judgment: 4. The trial Court after hearing the learned Advocates of both the sides framed 4 issues which are (i) is the suit maintainable in its present form; (ii) is the suit barred by limitation; (iii) are the plaintiffs entitled to get a decree as prayed for and (iv) what relief are the plaintiffs entitled to? Thereafter, the learned trial Court took evidences and decreed the suit and directed the appellant to execute and register the sale deed within 30 days from the date of the delivery of judgment.
